_comment: CX-NND-001 prepared SIFT100K monolithic REBUILD thread-invariance matrix.
Each P=1 run uses the existing HNSWMerger monolithic path to construct rows 0..100K from an empty HNSW.
Construction threads vary exactly across 1/2/4/8; thread count is part of the leaf cache key so matrix points cannot reuse one another.
build_calc and build_seconds preserve the backend canonical construction distance count and wall time.
The existing P=1 query-only path exposes final recall without modifying HNSWMerger.
The backend does not expose a seed config; hnswlib's constructor default seed=100 is recorded rather than falsely claimed configurable.

experiment_metadata.purpose: test approximate invariance of monolithic from-empty HNSW construction distance counts and quality under construction parallelism
